model-styling.goal: Create a polished fashion marketing image with a model wearing the referenced product.

campaign.goal: Create an aspirational campaign image featuring the referenced product.

product-detail.goal: Create a clean product-focused image that keeps attention on the referenced item.

variant-preview.goal: Create controlled alternate styling or material previews for the referenced product.

stylePresets.minimal-luxury: quiet luxury, restrained styling, refined materials, premium but understated mood
stylePresets.contemporary-streetwear: modern street styling, clean attitude, urban context, current fashion energy
stylePresets.resort: light resort styling, sunlit mood, effortless premium leisure feel
stylePresets.editorial-high-fashion: editorial styling, elevated mood, dramatic but controlled fashion presentation
stylePresets.clean-ecommerce: neutral commercial styling, clean lighting, product clarity first
stylePresets.department-store-catalog: commercial catalog polish, accessible styling, clear product presentation
